chunks.title: Never Blend Hot Ingredients
chunks.content: Never blend hot ingredients — this causes excessive steam and pressure buildup which can separate the vessel from the base, resulting in injury or property damage.

scenarios.condition: User wants to blend hot soup or liquid
steps: Allow ingredients to cool to room temperature before adding to vessel
Never blend hot or steaming ingredients
If the LED flashes red, the contents are too hot to safely blend - power off and let cool

chunks.title: Never Blend Carbonated Ingredients or Leavening Agents
chunks.content: Never blend carbonated ingredients or rising/leavening agents (baking powder, baking soda, yeast, etc.) as they can cause excessive pressure buildup, potentially causing injury or property damage.

scenarios.condition: User wants to blend carbonated drinks or baking ingredients
steps: Do not add carbonated beverages to the vessel
Do not add baking powder, baking soda, yeast, cream of tartar, or similar leavening agents

chunks.title: Blade Assembly and Interlock Safety
chunks.content: Blades are extremely sharp; never operate the blender without the vessel properly assembled to the blade housing, and never try to defeat the interlock mechanism.

scenarios.condition: Assembling or handling the blade assembly
steps: Always grasp the blade assembly by its housing, never touch the blade edge
Ensure the vessel is properly and fully installed before operating
Never attempt to bypass or defeat the safety interlock

chunks.title: Electric Shock Prevention
chunks.content: Do not put the cord, plug, or base in water or other liquid, do not use extension cords, and do not operate with a damaged cord or plug.

chunks.title: Keep Hands and Objects Clear of Vessel
chunks.content: Keep hands, hair, clothing, and utensils out of the vessel while powered on; a scraper may only be used when the appliance is not running.

chunks.title: Power Down Before Removing Vessel
chunks.content: Always turn the power switch off and wait until the motor has fully stopped, blades stop spinning, and ingredients settle before removing the blending vessel from the base.

chunks.title: One Minute Max Run Time
chunks.content: Never operate the unit for longer than one minute continuously; blade friction over prolonged periods can build heat and pressure in a closed vessel, risking injury or damage.

chunks.title: Keep Ventilation Holes Clear
chunks.content: Ensure the ventilation holes on the rear of the blender base are kept clean and never obstructed, to prevent overheating.

chunks.title: Do Not Store Ingredients With Blade Attached
chunks.content: Never store food in the blending vessel with the blade assembly attached, as active ingredients can release gases and build dangerous pressure; use the Storage Lid instead after allowing gases to escape.

chunks.title: Placement and Usage Restrictions
chunks.content: Always use the blender on a dry, stable, level surface at least 12 inches from the counter edge, never on/near hot surfaces, and never outdoors or in a microwave/dishwasher.

chunks.title: Do Not Overfill or Run Empty
chunks.content: Do not overfill the vessel beyond the MAX line and do not operate the blender with an empty vessel, both of which can damage the motor.

chunks.title: Thermal Overload Reset
chunks.content: If the blender overheats, a thermal switch will activate and shut off the motor; power off and let the unit cool for approximately one hour before using again.

chunks.title: Model & Electrical Specifications
chunks.content: This manual covers Model B10, rated 120 VAC, 60 Hz, max wattage 1000 W.

chunks.title: What's Included
chunks.content: B10 package includes: Blender Base, Blade Assembly, 1000mL Blending Vessel, Vessel Drinking Lid, Carry Cap, and Storage Lid; B10+ bundle adds a 500mL Blending Vessel and an additional Storage Lid.

chunks.title: Max Fill Lines for Blending
chunks.content: The 500mL vessel has a maximum fill of 350mL for blending; the 1000mL vessel has a maximum fill of 700mL for blending.

chunks.title: LED Light Indicator Meanings
chunks.content: The base LED indicates status: off=unit off, solid amber=on with no blade/vessel connected, solid white=ready to blend, solid green=blending in progress, flashing amber=motor overload, flashing red=contents too hot to blend.

rows: Unit On, No Blade and/or Vessel Connected
Vessel Contents Too Hot to Safely Blend

chunks.title: First-Time Setup and Cleaning
chunks.content: Before first use, remove the blade assembly by turning it counterclockwise, then hand wash all parts except the base and power cord in warm soapy water, rinse, and dry.

chunks.title: How to Use the B10 Blender (Blend Cycle)
chunks.content: Plug in and power on the base, fill the vessel with ingredients (at least 25% liquid, MAX line respected), attach the blade assembly clockwise, mount the vessel onto the base by twisting clockwise until it clicks, then press the Standby Switch for >1 second to start the automatic 1-minute timed blend cycle (20s blend, brief slowdown, 25s blend, brief slowdown, 15s blend, then stop).

chunks.title: Finishing a Blend and Storage Options
chunks.content: After blending, unmount the vessel by twisting counterclockwise, remove the blade assembly by turning counterclockwise, power off the base, then drink directly, attach the Drinking Lid and Carry Cap for on-the-go, or use the Storage Lid to refrigerate for later.

chunks.title: Pulse Function for Coarse Chopping
chunks.content: Press the Standby Switch for less than 1 second to pulse the blades, useful for coarsely chopping ingredients like coffee beans, salsa, or onions without fully emulsifying them; repeat until desired texture is reached.

chunks.title: Shake Method to Loosen Stuck Ingredients
chunks.content: If tough foods or limited liquid cause contents to stick, remove the blade assembly with vessel from the base, shake vigorously up and down, then reattach to the base to continue blending.

chunks.title: Vessel Fill Example Chart
chunks.content: Example ingredient loads and operating times: 1000mL vessel blends 280g carrots+420g water in 60s or grinds 600g wheat/rice/corn in 60s; 500mL vessel blends 140g carrots+210g water in 60s or grinds 100g coffee beans/spices in 20s.

chunks.title: No Visible Light on Base
chunks.content: If the LED shows no light, the unit is not powered on; confirm it is plugged into a working 120V outlet and press the power switch at the back.

rows: Confirm outlet works, press power switch at rear

chunks.title: Solid Amber Light - Blade/Vessel Not Connected
chunks.content: A solid amber light means the base is powered but the blade assembly and/or vessel is not properly connected; confirm the blade is firmly threaded and the vessel is twisted onto the base until it clicks, showing solid white when ready.

rows: Blade assembly and/or vessel not properly connected
Confirm blade is firmly threaded to vessel; twist vessel onto base until it clicks

chunks.title: Flashing Amber Light - Motor Overload
chunks.content: A flashing amber light indicates motor overload; power off, wait 30 seconds, then use the Shake Method if contents are stuck, reduce fill if overfilled, or let the motor cool for an hour if the light persists.

rows: Power off, wait 30s; free stuck ingredients (Shake Method) or reduce fill below Max Line; if persists, cool for 1 hour

chunks.title: Flashing Red Light - Contents Too Hot
chunks.content: A flashing red light means vessel contents are too hot to safely blend; power off, wait 30 seconds, and ensure contents are at or below room temperature before continuing.

rows: Contents too hot to safely blend
Power off, wait 30s, ensure contents are at/below room temperature

chunks.title: Motor Laboring or Inefficient Blending
chunks.content: If the motor sounds like it's laboring and blending is inefficient, the vessel may be overfilled or contents stuck; use the Shake Method to free ingredients, or remove excess contents below the Max Fill line and continue.

rows: Use Shake Method or reduce fill below Max Fill line, then continue blending

chunks.title: Routine Cleaning After Each Use
chunks.content: Clean the product immediately after each use as described in the Before Use section: hand wash removable parts in warm soapy water, rinse, and dry.

chunks.title: Rinse and Dry Blade Assembly
chunks.content: Rinse the Blade Assembly under tap water with a soapy sponge if necessary and dry on a drying rack; never place the Blade Assembly in the dishwasher, and never remove the gasket from it.

chunks.title: Clean Blending Vessels
chunks.content: Rinse the Blending Vessels and clean with the Beast brush if included; vessels may optionally be placed on the top rack of the dishwasher only.

chunks.title: Wipe Down Blender Base
chunks.content: Clean the Blender Base periodically with a damp towel or sponge; never immerse the base or power cord in water.

chunks.title: Prevent Staining on Light-Colored Parts
chunks.content: White and grey components can stain from turmeric, beets, carrots, or other bright ingredients; rinse these components immediately if contact occurs.

tasks.title: Wash Removable Parts Before First Use
tasks.description: Disassemble the blender and hand wash all removable parts before using it for the first time.
tasks.justification: Removes manufacturing residues and ensures food-safe first use.
tasks.instructions_text: Remove the Blade Assembly from the Blending Vessel by turning it counterclockwise. Hand wash all parts except the Blender Base and Power Cord in warm soapy water, then rinse and dry thoroughly.

tasks.title: Hand Wash Removable Parts After Each Use
tasks.description: Wash the vessel, lids, and blade assembly by hand after every use.
tasks.justification: Prevents food residue buildup, staining, and odor from leftover ingredients.
tasks.instructions_text: Hand wash all removable parts (vessel, lids, blade assembly) in warm soapy water immediately after use. Rinse thoroughly and dry.

tasks.title: Rinse and Dry Blade Assembly
tasks.description: Rinse the sharp blade assembly under tap water and dry on a rack after each use.
tasks.justification: Keeps blades free of food buildup and prevents corrosion or odor; the gasket must never be removed.
tasks.instructions_text: Rinse the Blade Assembly under running water, using a soapy sponge if needed. Dry it on a drying rack. Never place it in the dishwasher and never remove the gasket.

tasks.title: Wipe Down Blender Base
tasks.description: Wipe the exterior of the Blender Base periodically with a damp cloth.
tasks.justification: Cosmetic only — keeps the base free of spills and dust; the base must never be submerged.
tasks.instructions_text: Wipe the Blender Base with a damp towel or sponge as needed. Do not immerse the base or power cord in water.

tasks.title: Rinse Light-Colored Parts After Staining Contact
tasks.description: Immediately rinse white or grey components if they touch turmeric, beets, carrots, or other bright ingredients.
tasks.justification: Prevents permanent staining of light-colored plastic components.
tasks.instructions_text: If light-colored (white/grey) components contact staining ingredients like turmeric, beets, or carrots, rinse them immediately with soapy water.

tasks.title: Keep Ventilation Holes Clear
tasks.description: Check and keep the rear ventilation holes on the blender base free of dust and obstructions.
tasks.justification: Blocked vents can cause the motor to overheat, triggering thermal shutdown or reducing lifespan.
tasks.instructions_text: Periodically inspect the ventilation holes on the rear of the Blender Base and wipe away any dust or debris blocking them.

tasks.title: Cool Down After Thermal Overload
tasks.description: If the unit overheats and the thermal switch trips, power off and let it cool before resuming use.
tasks.justification: Restarting an overheated motor too soon can damage it further; the manual requires about an hour of cooldown.
tasks.instructions_text: If the motor overheats and shuts off, power off the unit at the rear switch and let it sit for approximately one hour before using it again.

re_check_triggers.description: Blender stops mid-cycle or LED flashes amber repeatedly
